items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Louis Primm and I used to go there every night and listen at him.

ctx.x: Kuyper, who was he great? Yes sir. The run of the sun went out of the joint. He was playing at the tannifor. He was playing at the entertainers for a long time. Louis Primm and I used to go there every night and listen at him. He was in the entertainers.
What sort of style did he have?
